thread:
alex: Escalation from AcmeHealth (private). Collector fails to upload debug bundle to our presign URL — customer sees 403. They attached collector logs and a curl repro. Can someone pick this up? Request IDs: req-54a1c9, req-54a1c9-collector:collector-07.

maya: On it. Do we have the exact presign URL they used and the collector version?

alex: Presign in their logs: https://redwood-presign.example/signed?X-Amz-Signature=... (redacted). Collector v2.3.1.

alex: Paste of their curl that reproduces 403:
```
curl -v -X PUT "https://redwood-presign.example/signed?X-Amz-..." \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \\n  --data-binary @debugbundle.tar.gz
```

jon: From the logs snippet they sent: `ERROR upload: 403 Forbidden (PresignExpired)` but timestamps look recent. Snippet: `2026-03-10T14:02:33Z collector upload req=req-54a1c9 status=403 presign_id=ps-7f2b`.

priya: Two quick checks: 1) Is the customer's clock skewed? 2) Are we rotating presign keys?

alex: Customer says system time is NTP-synced. They tried again after restarting collector, same result.

liz: Security note — they reported redaction mismatch earlier. We must ensure debug bundle redaction step ran before upload. If we request an alternate upload method, remind them to run `--redact` flag.

alex: Right. Their collector log shows `redact: completed, rules=default` earlier in the run. But the bundle they uploaded still contained IP addresses in a small test file. Could be redaction race.

maya: Can we generate a new presign for the same manifest and try an internal curl from our side to reproduce? If it's signature issue maybe our presigning lambda rotated keys.

priya: I'll check presign service logs for ps-7f2b. If keys rotated, we should see a mismatch. Also want the collector debug bundle manifest: `manifest.json` (they included SHA256 checksum).

alex: Manifest checksum: d2b2c9... They included `collector.log` lines referencing `manifest-signature=ps-7f2b`.

collector-bot: upload attempt failed: req=req-54a1c9 status=403 code=PresignInvalidSignature backend=presign-service node=redwood-presign-03

jon: If presign service is the cause we need an immediate workaround for the customer. Options: 1) Provide temporary SFTP endpoint and have them scp the bundle, 2) Request they run `redwood-collector --upload-proxy s3://fallback-bucket/` (airgap) — but that requires credentials.

alex: Customer prefers SFTP. They are on a private deployment (VPC) so SFTP endpoint must be reachable.

maya: I can spin up a one-time SFTP ingress on their VPC peering path, but need approval from security. Liz?

liz: Approve with conditions: 1) timeboxed (2 hours), 2) logs and upload path hashed, 3) require `--redact` to be re-run locally before transfer. We'll need an audit trail.

priya: Meanwhile I'll try repro from our side: will use the exact curl and their manifest to upload to a freshly generated presign from presign-service. If I see 403, I'll collect presign service request IDs and keys.

alex: Customer asked for minimal repro steps to include in their ticket so they can try again if we ask. Can we add a safe curl that includes `--trace` so they can send us headers without PII?

jon: Good idea. Suggest they run:
```
curl -v -X PUT "<presign-url>" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \\n  --trace-ascii - --data-binary @debugbundle.tar.gz > /dev/null
```
This prints headers and TLS handshake without uploading sensitive content to logs.

alex: I'll send that to them. Also asking them to re-run collector with `--redact` and attach `collector.log` and `manifest.json`.

maya: Update from me: I generated a new presign (ps-9a3c) and tried the exact curl they sent — upload succeeded from our test VM. So it's likely an issue on their path or an expired presign.

priya: I pulled presign-service logs: ps-7f2b was issued at 2026-03-10T13:50:10Z, TTL=10m, and the upload attempt was at 14:02:33Z -> expired. That explains 403. We should add clearer TTL messaging to collector error text.

alex: OK — action items: 1) I'll coordinate a fresh presign and request they re-upload immediately (with the `--trace-ascii` output), 2) Offer SFTP fallback if timing mismatch prevents immediate upload, 3) Ask them to re-run `--redact` and attach collector logs + manifest.

liz: For SFTP fallback: security needs the SFTP session logs and a signed acceptance from customer. Alex, collect that and loop me in.

jon: Also documenting repro steps for internal postmortem: presign TTL too short for their network latency and manual collection steps -> consider increasing TTL for private deployments or making presign refresh atomic with collector.

alex: Noted. I'll open a support ticket update with the presign TTL finding and the temporary SFTP offer. Keeping thread updated with any new traces. :thumbsup:
